name: stable-owned-source-index
goal: A unit owning several source files is fully fresh after one indexing pass, without changing caller file order.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: One indexing pass must produce the same complete unit metadata as every following pass, including groups owning several source files.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Synthetic move cases owned one file. Extend the same standardized suite with two files in reversed source order and assert second-pass metadata equality and unchanged caller map order.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: e86841b4 fails one-pass source indexing must be idempotent; immutable red f701acfb0dde16276554649a66fdb69f9c3b87978fb5eb110a347891b23b913d.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Sort only freshly constructed internal owned-file groups by path before deriving metadata; caller map order is unchanged.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: All ten unchanged unit-index cases pass at 478e6f1b; immutable green d9da095b2669ef9947aca89f3058043d0fe1209c6eeafa3f064a6fd75c2227e7.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
